create_entity.description: Create a feature, component, product, customer user or other entity. A feature needs a parent product or component, and a subfeature a parent feature. A customer user needs its email set before a note can be linked to it by that email. Returns the new entity's ID and link.
create_entity.name: create_entity

parameters.description: The kind of entity. The list shows the types this workspace has.
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.description: The entity's name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: For a 'user' entity: the email a note's customer relationship looks it up by. Only 'user' entities have this field; it is ignored on other types.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The entity this one sits under - its ID or Productboard URL. A feature needs a product or component; a subfeature needs a feature.
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.description: The entity's description. Plain text or HTML.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: A status name as it appears in Productboard, such as 'In progress', or a status ID.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A workspace member. Pick one, or type their email or member ID.
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: The teams responsible. On an update, these replace the current teams.
parameters.name: teams

parameters.description: Tag names. On an update, these replace the current tags.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: When the work starts. Needs an end date too.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: When the work ends. Needs a start date too.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: How Productboard shows the timeframe. Defaults to day.
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.description: Set the health by hand.
parameters.name: health_status

parameters.description: Why the health is what it is. Needs a health value.
parameters.name: health_comment

parameters.description: Values for custom fields, keyed by the field's ID. 'List entity types' shows each field's ID.
parameters.name: custom_fields

parameters.description: The system the record came from, such as 'zendesk'.
parameters.name: source_system

parameters.description: The record's ID in that system.
parameters.name: source_record_id

parameters.description: A link back to the record in that system.
parameters.name: source_url

create_note.description: Capture customer feedback as a note in the Productboard Insights inbox. Attach it to a customer by email (the user is created if Productboard has not seen them) or to a company, and link it to the feature it is about. Returns the new note's ID and link.
create_note.name: create_note

parameters.description: The note's title, up to 255 characters.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A text note holds one piece of text. A conversation holds a list of messages between a customer and your agents.
parameters.name: note_type

parameters.description: The feedback itself, for a text note. Plain text or HTML.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: For a conversation only: a list of messages, each with externalId, authorType ('customer' or 'agent'), content, timestamp and, optionally, authorName.
parameters.name: messages

parameters.description: Tag names. A tag that does not exist yet is created.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: A workspace member. Pick one, or type their email or member ID.
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: The customer this feedback is from, named by email. The user must already exist in Productboard - Productboard does not create one from an email given here. Create it first with 'Create entity' (entity type 'user', with its email field set).
parameters.name: customer_email

parameters.description: Instead of an email: the company this feedback is from. Use one or the other - a note has one customer.
parameters.name: customer_company_id

parameters.description: A feature or other entity this feedback is about - its ID or Productboard URL.
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.description: The system the record came from, such as 'zendesk'.
parameters.name: source_system

parameters.description: The record's ID in that system.
parameters.name: source_record_id

parameters.description: A link back to the record in that system.
parameters.name: source_url

delete_entity.description: Permanently delete an entity AND everything under it: deleting a component deletes its features and their subfeatures too. This cannot be undone - to hide an entity instead, archive it with 'Update entity'.
delete_entity.name: delete_entity

parameters.description: The feature, component, product or other entity's ID, or its Productboard URL. 'List entities' returns it as 'id'.
parameters.name: entity_id

delete_note.description: Permanently delete a note. This cannot be undone - to keep it out of the way instead, archive it with 'Update note'.
delete_note.name: delete_note

parameters.description: The note's ID, or its Productboard URL. 'List notes' returns it as 'id'.
parameters.name: note_id
